# Dermitage Anti-Aging Skin Care 2-Piece Set with Skin Renewal Complex and Reginex Instant Lifting Crème

## Renew Your Skin's Natural Radiance
Give your skin the hydration it needs with the Dermitage Anti-Aging Skin Care Set. This two-piece system pairs a moisturizing Skin Renewal Complex with Reginex Instant Lifting Crème for a complete daily renewal routine.

## Hydration Designed to Last
The renewal complex contains a powerful hydrating nutrient that keeps skin moisturized. Consistent use may help reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, so skin looks smoother and more supple.

## Supports Your Skin's Natural Collagen
This set enhances your skin's own collagen production to help regenerate its surface over time. Reginex Instant Lifting Crème helps create a lifted, refreshed look.

## Soothing, Protective Care
Soothing ingredients help calm the look of redness and swelling. The formula is also designed to help protect skin against free radical damage.

## A Smooth Base for Your Makeup
Apply it before foundation to create a smooth canvas, helping makeup glide on evenly.

## Start Your Renewal Routine Today
Add the Dermitage Anti-Aging Skin Care Set to your cart and give your skin the nourishment it deserves every day.
